encoding: JPEG, row 0 = north — same orientation as the heightmap
source: Digitale Orthophotos (DOP), Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung Hamburg (LGV)
attribution: Datenquelle: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung (LGV), dl-de/by-2-0
resolutionNote: The source is 20 cm. This drape is resampled by the WMS to about 14.7 m per pixel, because the terrain mesh beneath it is at 16 m posting and a 2-gigapixel texture is neither loadable nor useful. It is a photograph of the ground, not a measurement, and nothing is derived from it.
acquisition: LGV Hamburg aerial survey, leaf-on time series; the flight date varies by tile
